// AUTO-GENERATED by puerto from puerto.toml — never hand-edit. The snapshot follows the entity's
// fields; add an event with `puerto generate event Product <name>`.
use puerto_core::DomainEvent;
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
use uuid::Uuid;

use super::model::Product;

pub const PRODUCT_CREATED: &str = "product_created";
pub const PRODUCT_UPDATED: &str = "product_updated";
pub const PRODUCT_DELETED: &str = "product_deleted";

/// What every product event carries: the product as the API shows it — primitives, value
/// objects unwrapped. A public contract: consumers decode it with
/// `envelope.decode::<ProductSnapshot>()`.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
#[serde(rename_all = "camelCase")]
pub struct ProductSnapshot {
    pub id: Uuid,
    pub name: String,
    pub price: i64,
    pub sku: String,
}

impl ProductSnapshot {
    pub fn from_entity(entity: &Product) -> Self {
        Self {
            id: entity.id.value(),
            name: entity.name.clone(),
            price: entity.price,
            sku: entity.sku.clone(),
        }
    }
}

/// What happened to a product. Its write use cases record one through their unit of work.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq)]
pub enum ProductEvent {
    Created(ProductSnapshot),
    Updated(ProductSnapshot),
    Deleted(ProductSnapshot),
}

impl ProductEvent {
    pub fn snapshot(&self) -> &ProductSnapshot {
        match self {
            Self::Created(snapshot) | Self::Updated(snapshot) | Self::Deleted(snapshot) => snapshot,
        }
    }
}

impl DomainEvent for ProductEvent {
    fn event_type(&self) -> &'static str {
        match self {
            Self::Created(_) => PRODUCT_CREATED,
            Self::Updated(_) => PRODUCT_UPDATED,
            Self::Deleted(_) => PRODUCT_DELETED,
        }
    }

    fn aggregate_type(&self) -> &'static str {
        "product"
    }

    fn aggregate_id(&self) -> Uuid {
        self.snapshot().id
    }

    fn schema_version(&self) -> u16 {
        1
    }

    fn payload(&self) -> serde_json::Value {
        // A snapshot holds primitives only: serialising it cannot fail.
        serde_json::to_value(self.snapshot()).unwrap_or_default()
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    use crate::tests::mothers::product_mother::ProductMother;

    #[test]
    fn should_describe_every_event_when_one_is_recorded() {
        // Arrange
        let entity = ProductMother::random();
        let snapshot = ProductSnapshot::from_entity(&entity);
        let events = [
            (ProductEvent::Created(snapshot.clone()), "product_created"),
            (ProductEvent::Updated(snapshot.clone()), "product_updated"),
            (ProductEvent::Deleted(snapshot.clone()), "product_deleted"),
        ];

        for (event, event_type) in events {
            // Act + Assert
            assert_eq!(event.event_type(), event_type);
            assert_eq!(event.aggregate_type(), "product");
            assert_eq!(event.aggregate_id(), entity.id.value());
            assert_eq!(event.schema_version(), 1);
            assert_eq!(event.snapshot(), &snapshot);
        }
    }

    #[test]
    fn should_keep_the_json_contract_when_the_snapshot_is_serialised() {
        // Arrange
        let snapshot = ProductSnapshot::from_entity(&ProductMother::random());

        // Act
        let payload = ProductEvent::Created(snapshot.clone()).payload();

        // Assert — a renamed or removed key breaks every consumer of these events.
        let mut keys: Vec<&str> = payload
            .as_object()
            .map(|object| object.keys().map(String::as_str).collect())
            .unwrap_or_default();
        keys.sort_unstable();
        assert_eq!(keys, ["id", "name", "price", "sku"]);
        assert_eq!(
            serde_json::from_value::<ProductSnapshot>(payload).ok(),
            Some(snapshot)
        );
    }
}
